title: Total derived and exact condensed exchange agree as arrows
statement: For every commutative condensed coefficient ring Λ, commutative square of schemes and derived module complex M, the exchange arrow formed with total left derived pullback is isomorphic to the exchange arrow formed with exact localization of pullback. At the canonical bundled ℓ-adic coefficient, this exact exchange is the native comparison's specified exact exchange.

source.place: Constructibility and the isomorphism: restriction to affine charts and comparison of the specified exchange maps

proof.text: The total-to-exact comparison respects pullback composition: expand the canonical left-derived comparison and cancel its inverse. Equality induction gives compatibility with transport along an equality of scheme maps. Pasting across the square gives the forward pullback cube.
The total derived adjunction is the exact derived adjunction transported along the canonical left comparison. Its right mate is therefore the identity, by the triangle identity and naturality.

Invert the pullback cube and take its four mates. The two vertical right mates are identities, so exchangeMate_cube gives the commuting square between the total and exact exchange components. Its source and target comparisons are isomorphisms, which give the required arrow isomorphism.

theorem totalDerivedExchange_exact_comparisonFor
    (Λ : Sheaf (coherentTopology Profinite.{u}) Ab.{u + 1})
    [MonObj Λ] [IsCommMonObj Λ]
    {X' X Y' Y : Scheme.{u}} {v : X' ⟶ X} {p' : X' ⟶ Y'}
    {p : X ⟶ Y} {g : Y' ⟶ Y} (sq : CommSq v p' p g)
    (M : DerivedCategory (Mod (Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology X) Ab.{u + 1})
      (condensedRingObj Λ X))) :
    Nonempty (Arrow.mk ((CondensedRing.moduleObjectDerivedExchange
      Λ sq).app M) ≅
        Arrow.mk ((exactCondensedExchangeFor Λ sq).app M))
